source.title: Forebears Mali forenames and surnames frequency tables

names.notes: Public frequency tables support representative Malian names. This is not an official civil registry export; gender grouping remains a review seed.

source.title: ITU Mali national numbering plan communication of 6.III.2018

phones.notes: ITU/AMRTP confirms country code +223 and eight-digit national significant numbers. Earlier ITU plan-change communications identify mobile subscriber numbers under 6 for Sotelma/Malitel and 7 for Orange Mali; broad 9 generation was removed until confirmed as an active mobile range.

source.title: UPU Postal Addressing Systems: member-country address structures

locations.notes: Public postal references indicate Mali addressing is not supported here by a confirmed postcode grammar, so the generator uses BP-style internal prefixes. City and street values remain synthetic review samples.

national_identification_number_nina.label: National Identification Number (NINA)

source.title: IRB Canada Mali national identification number legal reference

national_identification_number_nina.notes: Public sources confirm the NINA exists and appears on Malian identity/voter documents, but no official public number length, checksum or semantic digit rule was confirmed. NINA is a generator marker, not a claimed literal prefix.

passport.label: Passport

source.title: PRADO Mali ordinary passport document entries

passport.notes: PRADO confirms Malian ordinary passport document families, including recent 2025 and 2016 entries. The public listing does not confirm passport-number grammar.
